file_contents.AGENTS.md:
# Repository instructions

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before pushing. CI runs the same
command on every push and pull request against `main`.
Keep schema changes and adapter changes in separate commits when practical.
New design note in `docs/decisions/`? Start from `docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md`.
file_contents.CONTRIBUTING.md:
# Contributing

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before pushing. CI runs the same
command on every push and pull request against `main`.

If a change alters something a design note describes, update the note in the
same pull request. Reviewers ask for this. Starting a new one? Copy
`docs/decisions/TEMPLATE.md`.

Open PRs fill in the checklist in `.github/pull_request_template.md`.

<The decision that was made and why it beat the rejected options.>

what would make this note stop describing what the code should do.>
